verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs describe asking its AI for 'instant answers and charts for anything in your account, from monthly spend to a full quarterly flux analysis' (expensify-docs-22) and fixing setup mistakes by asking (expensify-docs-4). Auto-categorization learns from policies and past behavior (expensify-docs-30), but one user reports it gets categories wrong about 70% of the time (expensify-comm-1). Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of the AI insights and charts, documentation of proactive (unprompted) suggestions, and evidence that categorization suggestions are accurate.
